item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Mapping\\n\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a deterministic, type-preserving representation of JSON data.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request: Mapping[str, Any], policy: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return review status for relevant, uniquely declared source paths.\\n\\n    Missing mapping entries are treated as the canonical missing state. Inputs are\\n    only read and are never normalized or modified in place.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", []))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    paths = {path for path in request.get(\\\"declared\\\", []) if path not in ignored}\\n    changed = sorted(\\n        path\\n        for path in paths\\n        if _canonical_json(saved.get(path, _MISSING))\\n        != _canonical_json(current.get(path, _MISSING))\\n    )\\n\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
